target.name: port-check
target.description: Report whether a TCP port on this machine is accepting connections.

capabilities.name: Check a port
capabilities.description: Report whether a port is open, and which process is listening on it when the platform can say.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: The TCP port to check, 1 through 65535.

outputs.name: stdout
outputs.description: One line: open or closed, with the listening process when known.

evidence.observed: read the script; it takes one positional port and prints a single status line
